confirmed.statement: S1 randomly assigned individual researchers to Low, Medium, or Intensive control; participants performed the task individually in a between-subjects design.

confirmed.statement: S1 recruited 54 researchers. The 54-person target and allocation of 18 per condition are described in the sample-size planning paragraph; actual assignment-stage totals and arm counts are not separately enumerated, so the form appropriately leaves n_randomized null.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Section 5.2, sample-size and recruited-sample paragraphs; p. 31, Appendix E, Table 8.

confirmed.statement: S1 excluded three extreme post-task survey responses using Isolation Forest: two unusually low and one unusually high. The source explicitly states: "This resulted in 51 valid data points, with 17 for each control level." Thus n_analyzed = 51 overall and 17 each for Low, Medium, and Intensive are supported.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 13, Section 5.3.1, paragraph immediately before Section 5.3.2.

confirmed.statement: S1-O1 uses the same 51-person analysis: the unique-proposal outcome has one-way ANOVA degrees of freedom (2, 48), consistent with 48 + 3 = 51 people in three arms. The two-arm behavioral tests have 32 degrees of freedom, consistent with 17 + 17 = 34 people.
